weight.description:
Number of points in the cluster. This represents the number of elements that
a single cluster absorbed when adding to the TDigest clusters

mean.description: Average value of the points in the cluster

qEnd.description:
qEnd: upper limit of the range of quantiles contained in this cluster
Note: lower limit of quantiles contained in this cluster is the qEnd of the previous cluster
(other than first cluster which has lower limit of 0). The range of
quantiles contained in a given cluster is [qEndPrevCluster, qEndThisCluster]
